# git-github-mcp
> FastMCP 2.14.4 portmanteau server for Git and GitHub operations. Uses `gh` CLI for GitHub; avoids the 40-tool explosion. - **git_ops**: clone, status, add, commit, push, pull, branch, tag, stash - **g...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
